claim_verdicts.evidence: Argo CD 3.1 Sync Phases and Waves: "When Argo CD starts a sync, it orders the resources in the following precedence:" "The phase", "The wave they are in (lower values first)", "By kind ...", "By name". No file criterion. Execution: gitops-order.txt:2 lists envs/staging/api.yaml first, yet :19 '5. wave 2: Deployment api created' is last.

refs k8s annotations.md:18 annotations "are not used to identify and select objects." Argo CD 3.1: "Hooks and resources are assigned to wave 0 by default." migrate-hook.yaml:14 argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1" (quoted string).

Round 2, reworded claim. Argo CD 3.1: the next wave "is the first number where any resource is out-of-sync or unhealthy"; "There is currently a delay between each sync wave" (none inside a wave). Sync hook "Executes ... at the same time as the application of the manifests"; a failed hook fails the sync. Execution: migrate has no readinessProbe, yet api creation sorts after migrate finishedAt (gitops-order.txt:17-19), so wave 1 completed on Succeeded.

Round 2. Argo CD 3.1 hook table: PreSync "Executes prior to the application of the manifests." Sync "... at the same time as the application of the manifests." PostSync "Executes after all Sync hooks completed and were successful...". The same table also lists Skip, SyncFail ("Executes when the sync operation fails.") and PostDelete, so 'before, with or after' is not the whole set of values. "Hooks can be any type of Kubernetes resource kind".
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: The annotation's value is the hook's phase, which says when it runs; for example, `PreSync` runs before the other objects, `Sync` with them and `PostSync` after them.

issues.text: New in round 2 (changed hook bullet). The sentence presents before/with/after as the full range of phase values; Argo CD 3.1's hook table also lists Skip, SyncFail and PostDelete. Claim 4 itself says 'not the full list', but the lesson text does not.
issues.quote: The annotation's value is the hook's phase, which says whether it runs before, with or after the other objects; `Sync` means with them.
issues.fix: Replace with: "The annotation's value is the hook's phase, which says when it runs; for example, `PreSync` runs before the other objects, `Sync` with them and `PostSync` after them." If `PreSync`/`PostSync` must not be named, write "which says when it runs, for example before, with or after the other objects".
